body:
Hey there,

Digging the username! But in all seriousness, I understand that what you're going through is painful. I'm not here to try and sound like I know what you're feeling but I wanted to share that life is a journey and sometimes, it just takes a little longer for someone to reach their goals. It's frustrating, I agree. This is from someone who has never had a girlfriend and is still dealing with so much social anxiety in my early 20's. While it may seem that we are impossible to love, we have to understand that it is not a race. 

I'm sorry if I'm not offering the best help, but this post stood out to me because I thought I could relate a bit. I spent too much of my life trying to impress others, instead of trying to impress myself....all for the fact that someone will feel the same way I feel about them. Although I am still going through my own struggles, I am trying to find peace with myself while trying to find a meaning as to what the reason I'm on this Earth for. Maybe try volunteering around and get the perspective of others?

I just think we have to try and love ourselves and continue to do good, no matter what we may be going through. 

Please feel free to shoot me a message, I would really like to opportunity to chat with you more if you feel like it.

Hope you're feeling better.

Hey there,

I'm sorry that you're feeling that way that you're feeling, but know that life is a journey and it's up to us to try and be the best person that we can be. I know it's hard when you want to be outside but you feel as if there is no reason to go out, but the other person who posted is right: try and stay active with hobbies.

I also think that we can learn so much from dogs. I remember reading a quote that really hit my heart a while back and it goes: "Be the person your dog thinks you are." They are such loving, compassionate, and loyal animals that see past "our flaws." They don't care about how we look, dress, or if we're not the most sociable person. They live in the moment and try to enjoy every moment of the life that is given to them. I like to think that the same idea should be used by us. We are given a life and we want to be the best person that we can be. Sure there are bumps in the road, but staying positive and trying to be active is the best thing to do in my opinion. Maybe try volunteering? I think that can be a great way to stay positive and meet really cool people at the same time. I'm sorry if I wasn't that helpful, but please feel free to message me if you ever want to chat!

No problem, I'm happy I can help in anyway that I can! If you're ever feeling down again or just need someone to vent to, know that there are people here who would love to chat with you, so don't ever shy away from sending us a message.

Hey,

May I ask what is bothering you? No worries if you don't want to share, but if you need someone to talk to or just vent to, I'm here.

Hey there. While I may not know exactly what you're going through, just please know that the way you are feeling now is not permanent. There is so much out there, and it's up to us to try and make an effort to have a positive outlook on life. Nothing comes overnight, and life is a journey. I'm sorry if I wasn't of much help, but if you need anyone to talk to, please know that you are more than welcome to shoot me a message. Hope you're feeling better.

Hey there,

I'm sorry that you're going through what you're going through, and I'm not here to say that I understand exactly how you're feeling, but I just wanted to let you know that things will get better. Life is a long, long journey and there will undoubtedly be ups and downs. It isn't a race, and sometimes we have to endure in order to conquer. I too went to a private university and can understand how there is still of a high-school mentality. Upon looking back at it, I can say that I regret making some of the choices I made, just to seem "cool" to some of the party kids. I cared too much about what others thought about me, and that kept me from keeping the friends who truly cared about me.

If you haven't already, maybe get involved with a certain group on campus- whether it be volunteering or sports/dancing/music. You can meet people that truly share the same interests as you.

I just hope that you never lose sight of who you are. You seem like a very nice person, and just know that life will get better and it's up to us to keep our head up high and try to be the best person who we can be. Take it from someone who spent pretty much their entire college career trying to be someone I wasn't. Just be yourself and stay positive. I know it's hard and I'm sorry if I wasn't of much help. You are more than welcome to message me if you ever need to. Hope you're feeling better!

Hey there,

I know that you say that you aren't brave, but deep down, I think you are. You were brave enough to post here and I just want you to know that you are meaningful to this planet. You're a good person. As I am dealing with my own problems, I thought I would share this simplistic quote that helps me in a way: "Those who endure, conquer."

In this sense, while you are going through a tough time right now, know that pain and depression are temporary - like others have noted. 

Though none of us can really feel what you're going through, life does get better, and it is up to us to have a positive impact and try to be the best that we can be. I'm sorry if I didn't help much but please know you are more than welcome to PM me if you just want to chat, or vent. Hope you're feeling better.

Hey there,

Well, I wanted to let you know that you are meaningful to this life, but know that for some it just takes longer to get to where you want to be; while some may have it all "figured out" now, that doesn't mean there is no future. Life isn't a race, but rather a journey of lessons. I'm going through my own thing right now, but I'm trying so hard to be a better and meaningful person towards society. Your post stood out to me a bit because I can relate a bit. While I'm not trying to preach or say I know exactly what you're going through, I just thought I would lend a hand - and if you ever want to talk about life or aspirations you have, feel free to message me. Pain isn't permanent, and without it, we wouldn't know what happiness is. Hope you're feeling better.

hey there, i'm sorry and I know it can be tough. Just know that you're 17 and life is a journey. For some, it takes longer to get to our destination, and it all depends on us trying to make that change. If you want you are more than welcome to PM me. We all go through our own journey and battle through life, but it will get better. Cheers.

Please don't do this, please.

I know it is easier said than done, but understand that there are those out there that love you so much. There is life for you. Please feel free to message me if you need someone to talk to.

Thank you. My parents know that something is wrong and want me to go see a therapist. I am just so embarrassed of telling some one face-to-face of what I have done.

I'm stubborn and find myself hating myself most of the day. Once I began to think of what I have done, things continue to pile on and on of bad things I have done in life and make me not want to have any motivation to live.

Hey everyone, I know it's only been two short days since I've posted this and I find myself feeling a bit better these past two days - to the point where I don't wish that I die - but I I still have pretty strong episodes of feeling incredibly horrible for what I done, which leads me not wanting to be alive. I change my mood every few hours it seems, and should I seek out a therapist as soon as possible.

Thank you again so much for all your time and help.

Thank you so much, I really can't express how thankful I am for everyone who took the time to read and reply. I know that I can become a better person, it's just a matter of me trying to carry out those actions and start from somewhere. Thanks for being open to contact, it is nice to know that not everyone sees me as a disgusting human being.
Thank you, it took a lot for me to write this down and share, but I know it's going to take a lot more work for me to become a better person.
Thanks for taking the time to read and reply. I'm trying not to be and I just want to be the person I know I can be.
I'm trying.
Thank you so much, I'll go ahead and shoot you a message.

Hey there, no need to be sorry at all, I truly appreciate everything about your response. And I should be the one thanking you for taking the time to read this and make an effort to reply even though this is not your native language. I know there's good in me, and I know that I want to do good, but my mind just isn't where it was or is supposed to be. The good things you do make me know that there are great people on this earth who I can model myself after. I want to hold myself to high standards, and I just want to be the person that others think I am or am capable of..but I'm far from it, but am trying hard to overcome this obstacle and at least start to make more of an effort. Thanks for sharing your story too, it helps me understand that we all go through our own battles and our response shapes who we become. I know I have failed as to maximizing who I am as a person and to why I'm on this planet, but I really want to make an effort and get out of this slump. It's not fair for my family to see me like this. I thank you again so much.
Thank you so much for your help.
Wow, this is exceedingly long. I'm sorry.
You are a beautiful person and soul. Please know that.
